title: Equipment repairs
body: For a projector repair, record the room, asset tag and error message. A service operator approves the request before a repair ticket is created. Do not promise a repair time before technician confirmation.

title: Borrowing equipment
body: Equipment collection requires a confirmed reservation and an identity check at the service desk. Return borrowed equipment before the reservation ends. Contact the service operator when an item is damaged.

title: Network troubleshooting
body: If the network connection fails, record whether other devices are affected and whether the connection uses Ethernet or WiFi. Check the cable and restart the local adapter. Never share passwords in a support ticket.
